edit.insertText.description: Insert text at a Unicode character offset in a story or table cell.

edit.deleteText.description: Delete the half-open character range [start,end) in a story or cell.

edit.paragraphStyle.description: Apply a paragraph style to the paragraphs touched by the range.

edit.characterStyle.description: Apply a character style to the range.

edit.textFormat.description: Set local formatting properties on the range.

edit.styleCreate.description: Create a paragraph or character style in the document. With a story range, use its formatting and optionally apply the new style.

edit.styleEdit.description: Edit a paragraph or character style. All text using it in the document can change.

edit.styleRedefine.description: Redefine the style from the range. All document text using it can change.

edit.styleDelete.description: Delete a style and reassign its uses to the replacement in this document.

edit.findReplace.description: Replace all literal text or formatting matches in the scope. To change one match, use its selection range. Offsets count Unicode characters.

edit.threadText.description: Link the text frame to the next frame, or disconnect its outlet by omitting next. The story can reflow.

edit.createThreadFrame.description: Create the next frame in a thread on the specified page. rect is [left,top,right,bottom] in spread points.

edit.textFrameOptions.description: Change the text frame options, including columns and inset spacing.

edit.toggleList.description: Toggle bullets or numbering for the paragraphs in the range. numbers selects numbering.

edit.toggleNumberingRestart.description: Toggle restarting the list number in the selected paragraphs.

edit.insertTable.description: Insert an inline table at the story character offset. Cell IDs from tableInfo.table.cells can be used as stories for text edits.

edit.deleteTable.description: Remove the table and all its cells from the current document.

edit.insertRows.description: Insert count rows relative to the zero-based row at. before selects the side.

edit.insertColumns.description: Insert count columns relative to the zero-based column at. before selects the side.

edit.deleteRows.description: Delete count rows starting at the zero-based row at, including their contents.

edit.deleteColumns.description: Delete count columns starting at the zero-based column at, including their contents.

edit.applyCellStyle.description: Apply a cell style to the listed [column,row] coordinates.

edit.clearCellOverrides.description: Clear local style overrides in the listed [column,row] cells.

edit.applyTableStyle.description: Apply a table style to the table.

edit.clearTableOverrides.description: Clear local style overrides from the table.

edit.createTableStyle.description: Create a table or cell style. kind selects table or cell.

edit.editTableStyle.description: Rename or edit a table or cell style. All document tables or cells using it can change.

edit.deleteTableStyle.description: Delete a table or cell style and assign its uses to the replacement.

edit.duplicateTableStyle.description: Duplicate a table or cell style in the open document.

edit.createTableStyleGroup.description: Create a table or cell style group, optionally under parent.

edit.renameTableStyleGroup.description: Rename a group of table or cell styles.

edit.deleteTableStyleGroup.description: Delete a group of table or cell styles in this document.

edit.moveTableStyle.description: Move a table or cell style into a group, or to the root by omitting group.
